in_sanskrit.name: Mushtaque
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Chosen one, beloved
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mushtaque एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mushtaque is derived from the Arabic word 'mushtaq', meaning 'the one who is longed for or desired'. In Hindu context, it can be considered as 'chosen one' or 'beloved'.
